about: Informational, not scored. duel.com Keno configuration as fetched 2026-10-05 in a logged-in session (read-only GET), evidence E14, compared with the audited April table kenoConfig.json. Generated by `npm run live-config` (src/live-config.ts).

method.rtp: exact rational: Σ_k C(n,k)·C(40−n,10−k)/C(40,10) × the tier multiplier literal (src/exact.ts); the operator probabilities field is not used
method.rtpBound: a tier mismatches when |RTP − (1 − house_edge)| exceeds 5×10^-(p+1), p = decimal places of the longest multiplier literal in that tier
method.maxProfitAtMaxBet: last tier max_bet × (largest multiplier of the last tier − 1), printed to 6 decimals; the response carries no max-profit field
method.baseTier: the house_edge 0.001 tier compared cell by cell (parsed values) with kenoConfig.json data.multipliers[risk][picks]
method.multiplierLiterals: 14156 multiplier literals in 2672 tier arrays, all equal to String(parsed value)
